title: add_classification
description: Register a category account → its Account type. Promotes pending entries with it and extends chart_of_accounts (origin='extension'). Categories only — a payee is not an account.

account.description: A canonical category account on the line item (e.g. 'CASH', 'SUPPLIES_EXPENSE') — never a per-vendor account; a payee is not an account.

account_type.description: Canonical accounting bucket the account belongs to.

notes.description: Optional free-form note — surfaced to operator agent for agreement review.
